rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 68, ARTICLE IX OF BATAS PAMBANSA BILANG 881, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, BY PROVIDING THE COMMISSION ON ELECTIONS WITH ADDITIONAL MECHANISMS TO CHECK THE REAL CITIZENSHIP OF CANDIDATES FOR ELECTIVE OFFICE
rows.abstract: Proposes included  in Section 68 of the  Omnibus Election Code:  "BEFORE, UPON OR AFTER THE FILING OF HIS CERTIFICATE OF  CANDIDACY, THE DEPARTMENT  OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS,   THE COMMISSION ON IMMIGRATION AND DEPORTATION, OR  THE OFFICE  OF THE SOLICITOR-GENER AL,  MOTU PROPIO, OR  AT THE FORMAL AND WRITTEN REQUEST OF THE CHAIRMAN   OF THE COMMISSION, SHALL FURNISH  AND CAUSE TO BE FURNISHED  THE NECESSARY PAPERS  AND DOCUMENTS   TO ESTABLISH THE REAL CITIZENSHIP OF THE PERSON SEEKING TO BECOME  ACANDIDATE FOR AN ELECTIVE PUBLIC OFFICE."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 1992-12-07

rows.abstract: Seeks  to substantiate the provision (Art XI, Section 18) which states that: "Public officers and employees  owe the State   and this Constitution allegiance at all times, and any public officer or employee who seeks to change     his citizenship oracquire the status     of an  immigrant of  another country during  his tenure shall be dealt  with by law."  * * *
